title.value: Improving Compositional Generalization using Iterated Learning and Simplicial Embeddings
title.justification: This is directly taken from the first line of the paper, which explicitly states the title.
title.quote: Improving Compositional Generalization using Iterated Learning and Simplicial Embeddings

extractions.description: The paper explores the challenge of compositional generalization in deep learning models, which is the ability to generalize to unseen combinations of latent factors. The authors propose utilizing a process inspired by human language evolution, called 'iterated learning,' to enhance this capability in deep networks. By implementing iterated learning on models with simplicial embeddings, which approximately discretize representations, the paper demonstrates improved compositional generalization. This approach is applied to both controlled vision tasks and molecular graph prediction tasks, showing significant improvement over existing methods.
